label: Dresses — one-piece
note: Authored, never generated. A dress occupies its own slot and suppresses both top and bottom, so the campaign styles footwear only. Movement and seated shots matter more here than in any other category: drape, volume and how the skirt falls when seated are the properties that drive both purchase and return.
preserve_fields: the fabric colour, pattern scale and placement
the neckline shape and any strap or sleeve
the bodice construction, seaming and waist position
the skirt length, volume and how it falls
the closure — zip, buttons or tie — and its placement
the hem finish and any trim, slit or lining edge

ref_descriptions.front: the front of a dress photographed flat on a headless mannequin
ref_descriptions.back: the BACK of the same dress photographed on a mannequin
ref_descriptions.detail: a macro of the same dress's fabric, neckline and trim

blocks.keep_onmodel: Keep the SAME {{campaign.pronoun.noun}} (identical face, hair, skin tone and build), the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its fabric, pattern, neckline, waist and length unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not redraw, restyle, recolour, resize or reposition the neckline, seaming, pattern or trim. Do not lengthen or shorten the hem. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic anywhere on the garment.
blocks.tail: {{campaign.grade}}, sharp focus, no motion blur, no extra text or logos.
blocks.no_person: ABSOLUTELY NO human presence: no skin, no neck, no shoulders, no legs, no body underneath the fabric. Nothing but cloth.
blocks.flatlay_setup: flat-lay product photography, no person and no mannequin anywhere in the frame. The {{category.garment_noun_short}} is laid flat and face-up on {{campaign.flatlay_surface}} and photographed from directly above
